question: A train 250m long running at 72 km/hr crosses a platform in 26 seconds. What is the length of the platform?
explanation: Speed = 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 26 = 520m. Platform length = 520 - 250 = 270m.

question: Two trains running in the same direction at 40 km/hr and 22 km/hr. The faster train passes a man in the slower train in 36 seconds. Find the length of the faster train.
explanation: Relative speed = 40 - 22 = 18 km/hr = 18 × 5/18 = 5 m/s. Length = Speed × Time = 5 × 36 = 180m.

question: A train passes a telegraph pole in 10 seconds and a 300m long bridge in 25 seconds. Find the speed of the train.
shortcutMethod: Bridge covered in extra 15s. Bridge = 300m. Speed = 300/15 = 20 m/s = 72 km/hr.
formulaUsed: Speed = (Bridge Length) / (Time for bridge - Time for pole)
